vedic_reference.note: Vishvaksena is a name of Lord Vishnu and is also the name of the commander-in-chief of his army. It is found in the Vedas and other Hindu scriptures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vishvaksena holds a significant place in Hindu mythology and culture. It is often chanted before the beginning of any new venture, such as starting a business or embarking on a journey, to seek his blessings and guidance. Vishvaksena is considered the Supreme Commander of the entire universe, and he assists Lord Vishnu in maintaining the cosmic order and harmony.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Vishvaksena holds deep spiritual significance, representing the celestial sibling and aide of Lord Vishnu. In Hindu mythology, Vishvaksena is considered to be Lord Vishnu's Vahan (vehicle) and his Y shifting (flag). He is a steadfast companion, who is always present by Lord Vishnu's side to serve Him and protect the universe from chaos and disorder.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Vishvaksena is a name of the god of the gods in the Mahabharata. The name Vishvaksena carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Vishvaksena is the name of the chief minister of the gods in Hindu mythology.
